BL-1969 — ./swarm ensure leaves a GPU-quiet local-model seat down until the /gpu pause ends - today its per-role loop recreates every missing session, so babysitter's swarm-starved repair (or any other ensure) during a pause starts qwen and puts the model back on the GPU
What it solves: ## What is wanted
Approval context: FIRM: while the /gpu pause is active, no ./swarm ensure started by babysitter recreates a local-model seat's session; every other seat is ensured as before; the seat comes back on the first ensure after the pause ends. The one choice is whether a ./swarm ensure the operator runs by hand during a pa…
